title.narrative: Strengthening quality assurance and performance excellence in Thai higher education

description.narrative: Specifically the IDF would support two components: o Component 1: Strategic technical assistance inputs to strengthen the Office of the Higher Education Commission's ability to design and execute improved performance excellence system that will respond to specific contexts of universities through self-assessment that identifies maturity levels for further improvements. This component would also include piloting the system in both public and private universities. Component 2: Strategic technical assistance inputs to strengthen the Office of the Higher Education Commission's ability to promote performance excellence system and self-assessment process, coordinated by an autonomous unit to support and facilitate the overall system. Link to CAS and/or ESW (core diagnostics, e.g., CPAR, CFAA, PER, CEM, etc.), and relationship to Bank operations The development objective of this grant is to enhance the capacity of the Office of Higher Education Commission (OHEC) in the area of quality assurance and performance excellence in higher education.
